# Source API reference

Rebuild: `python3 tools/docs/build_reference.py`. Check: `python3 tools/docs/build_reference.py --check`.

Every first-party runtime GDScript, shader and non-test Python tool is listed. Tests, vendor add-ons, imported assets and shell commands belong in developer guides.

Types marked `not declared` are unannotated; `inferred from default` preserves GDScript inference syntax. No dynamic object types, schemas, units or nullable returns are guessed.

Coverage: 243 files; 3898 functions, 80 signals, 2805 properties, 169 uniforms.
